canonicalPlan: unlimited vacations for the whole year

allow.note: A customer-facing string that matches this pattern is TimeSyncher product billing through Stripe (subscription, billing portal, invoice, or the product checkout/payment/charge). It is not a trip reservation, a booking the app places, or a deposit for a stay. The whole string is skipped for BAR-RESERVATION-PAYMENT. A string that only mentions Stripe, or only mentions checkout or payment, is not allowlisted.

collabUrl.sitePhrase: vacation website|website link|here is the|open the vacation
collabUrl.note: A collaborator-seat reply builder is a function whose name matches builderName. A hit is a template literal in that function that contains sitePhrase and a ${...} interpolation.

exempt.note: Path exemptions apply to source scans only. Dialog pack turns are chat, so the pack checker does not use these paths.

BAR-RESERVATION-PAYMENT.note: TimeSyncher product purchase only. Chat, replies, and prompts that talk about booking or paying for trip things stay in scope.

BAR-UNLIMITED-WORDING.note: Checkout modules only. Chat, replies, and prompts stay in scope.

BAR-SPLIT-PAYER.note: Checkout modules only. Chat, replies, and prompts stay in scope.

BAR-COLLAB-URL.note: Collaborator invite email builders. A chat reply to a collaborator seat stays in scope.

BAR-THING-CUSTOMER.note: On these keepsake and trek files, comments, new Error strings, skipReason strings, and a bare Thing identifier are internal. A || Thing display fallback and any other prose stay, because that text can be shown. Prompts and chat stay in scope.

exactAllow.note: Literal equality of the source text inside the quotes, only in these two files. Not a regex. A paraphrase fails. The same text in any other file fails. Dialog pack turns are chat and do not use this list.
strings: Reservations, payments, split-payer, or other language the reply rules ban.
Do not mention reservations, payments, or checkout.
Item34 ban: never say "splitting payments", split payment, split-payer, splitting payment, or splitting anything up. If one seat is already covered and another person has their own seat, say that.

Rate this draft as the customer-facing vacation reply. Return a score only. Criterion 1 is weak. Criterion 5 is excellent. Use criterion 1 or 2 when it misses the ask, names a place that has no search-result id, skips a price they asked for, says no extra fees instead of the price, says the plan is already owned, or uses a banned payment word. A place cited as (id:...) from a search or database result is already sourced. A price question that does not include required_payer_line, when that line is in the state, is criterion 3 or lower. Days and places listed in the itinerary state are already named.
